caption: The drawing features a long-sleeved, floor-length dress prominently centered on a plain, light background. The dress is rendered in shades of brown and beige, with a repeated floral pattern in a darker tone covering the entire garment. The dress has a fitted bodice with a slightly rounded neckline and a seam at the waistline, from which the skirt falls in pleated, vertical lines. The long sleeves are loose and slightly flared at the wrists, with the same floral pattern throughout. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller line drawing of the same dress, showing the garment’s structure and pleats without color or pattern, viewed from the back. The bottom right corner contains a handwritten name, "David P. Willoughby." The overall composition is clean, with the focus on the dress and minimal additional elements or details in the background.
title: Wedding Dress
